```lean
intros w
obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := CategoryTheory.Limits.hasKernels.mk' f
obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := CategoryTheory.Limits.hasKernels.mk' (f ≫ k)
obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := CategoryTheory.Limits.hasKernels.mk' (k ≫ f)
have h1 : k = 0 := by
  rw [hk, hi]
  apply CategoryTheory.Simple.ker_eq_zero
  exact w
have h2 : k = 0 := by
  rw [hc, hk]
  apply CategoryTheory.Simple.ker_eq_zero
  exact w
exact CategoryTheory.IsIso.of_inverse (CategoryTheory.Limits.ker_inv f) (by rfl)
```
